title: Corr edit sidecar
description: Sidecar next to a media file (MyMovie.mkv → MyMovie.corr.json). Playback applies mute, volume, beep, zoom, crop, blur, pixelate, cover, blank, and skip. Other actions are reserved. Non-length-altering edits are applied before length-altering edits (skip/cut). Output frame size never changes (crop pads with black). All times are on the original source timeline and are never adjusted for cuts.

runtime.description: Original source runtime in seconds (not the edited duration).

id.description: Stable id for per-user honor/ignore. If omitted, the plugin synthesizes {action}:{start}:{end}.

start.description: Range start in seconds on the original source timeline. Never adjusted for cuts or other length-changing edits.

end.description: Range end in seconds on the original source timeline; must be greater than start. Never adjusted for cuts or other length-changing edits.

action.description: Playback applies mute, volume, beep, zoom (alias punch), crop, blur (alias boxblur), pixelate (alias mosaic), cover (alias blackout), blank, and skip. Other values are ignored until supported.

items.description: FFmpeg channel label, e.g. FL, FR, FC, LFE, BL, BR, SL, SR.

channels.description: For mute, volume, and beep: named source channels to affect (FC, FL, FR, …). Omit or empty = all channels. Names not present in the source layout are ignored; if none remain, the edit falls back to all channels (so FC-only still works on stereo).

gain.description: Volume: linear source gain (default 0.2). Beep: tone amplitude (default 0.3). Ignored for mute.

frequency.description: Beep tone frequency in Hz. Default 1000.

scale.description: Zoom/crop factor (> 1). Default 2. Ignored when box is set.

x.description: Zoom/crop center X at range start, 0–1. Default 0.5.

y.description: Zoom/crop center Y at range start, 0–1. Default 0.5.

x_end.description: Zoom/crop center X at range end. Linear pan from x. Omit for a static zoom/crop.

y_end.description: Zoom/crop center Y at range end. Linear pan from y. Omit for a static zoom/crop.

radius.description: Boxblur luma radius in pixels (single pass; power is not configurable). Default 8. Clamped per plane so luma cannot exceed half the region and chroma cannot exceed half the subsampled chroma size.

size.description: Pixelate block size in pixels. Default 16. Clamped to 2–128.

box.description: Normalized region at range start. Zoom: crop this box and scale it to fill the frame. Crop: keep this box and pad with black to the original frame size. Blur/cover/pixelate: apply only inside this region (omit for full-frame). Ignored for blank.

width.description: Width, 0–1. Omit to keep box width.

height.description: Height, 0–1. Omit to keep box height.

box_end.description: Normalized region at range end. X/Y lerp from box on the original timeline (pan). Width/height stay at the start box because FFmpeg crop size is not per-frame.

categories.description: Content tags used to turn sidecar treatments on or off. Preferred ids match the dashboard taxonomy (profanity, word_ass, sex_with_nudity, graphic, …). A parent id applies the whole group; a word id applies that word only. The action on the edit still decides mute vs beep vs crop vs skip. Aliases: sex, nudity, ass, fuck, violence, language. Unknown tokens map to other.
